SPY.name: US equities
SPY.formula: 100 × mean(last 4 quarterly annualised NFCPATAX) / same-quarter equity market value in billions
SPY.limitation: US nonfinancial corporations, not S&P 500 constituents or CAPE; quarterly release lag.

IEF.name: Nominal Treasuries
IEF.limitation: Nominal yield, not expected real return or the exact yield/duration of IEF.

GLD.name: Gold
GLD.formula: log(completed-month unadjusted GLD close / same-month CPIAUCSL)
GLD.limitation: Price-reversion proxy, not fundamental gold fair value; ETF expenses affect long history.

TIP.name: Inflation-linked Treasuries
TIP.limitation: Constant-maturity real yield, not the exact yield/duration of TIP.

DBC.name: Commodity futures
DBC.measure: Log producer prices relative to CPI
DBC.limitation: Broad producer-price basket, not DBC holdings, commodity fair value or futures carry.

sources.title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items in U.S. City Average

limitations: Retrospective extension designed after earlier research was inspected; no untouched holdout.
Value measures differ by asset. Gold and commodities use price proxies, not fundamental fair value.
Positive value z means relatively cheaper / higher yield; positive price z means above historical log price.
Equal z-scores across assets do not imply equal expected returns or probabilities.
Nominal Treasury yield is not expected real return; real Treasury yield is not the exact TIP portfolio yield.
Monthly outcome windows overlap and are not independent observations.
Latest scores are dated research snapshots using completed prices, not live quotes.
Missing post-inception forecasts remain cash; all headline models share input and outcome eligibility.
No confirmed predictive advantage is inferred from these historical results.
